business_summary: Shandong Hongqiao Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of aluminum products in China and internationally. It offers electrolytic, liquid, recycled, and oxidized aluminum, as well as aluminum alloy, aluminum hydroxide, alumina, and deep-processed aluminum products. The company is also involved in trading; investment management; and logistics businesses. It exports its products. The company was formerly known as Shandong Hontron Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited and changed its name to Shandong Hongqiao Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited in January 2026. Shandong Hongqiao Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Binzhou, China. Shandong Hongqiao Aluminum Industry Holding Company Limited operates as a subsidiary of Shandong Weiqiao Aluminum and Electricity Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Shandong Hongqiao Aluminium Industry Holding Company Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 알루미늄 제품의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 전해, 액체, 재활용 및 산화 알루미늄은 물론 알루미늄 합금, 수산화알루미늄, 알루미나 및 심층 가공 알루미늄 제품을 제공합니다. 회사는 거래에도 참여하고 있습니다. 투자 관리; 및 물류 사업. 자사 제품을 수출하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Shandong Hontron Aluminium Industry Holding Company Limited로 알려졌으며 2026년 1월에 Shandong Hongqiao Aluminium Industry Holding Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Shandong Hongqiao Aluminium Industry Holding Company Limited는 2000년에 설립되었으며 중국 빈저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Shandong Hongqiao Aluminium Industry Holding Company Limited는 Shandong Weiqiao Aluminium and Electricity Co., Ltd.의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
